headline: 3-of-5 governance multisig owns proxyAdmin, MarketFactoryV3 and controls upgrades/fees with no timelock on fast path

findings.text: V2 governance at 0x8119EC16F0573B7dAc7C0CB94EB504FB32456ee1 is 3-of-5 Gnosis Safe proxy (implementation 0x34CfAC646f301356fAa8B21e94227e3583Fe3F5F); owners exactly match address_book list; threshold=3 (defipunkd surfacer + Etherscan proxy read at block ~25064682-89).

Router V3 is diamond proxy (0x00000000005BBB0EF59571E58418F9a4357b68A0) with 6 facets including 0x8086174bE8FC721CbF275545193a73f56FBF3384; upgrade via DiamondCut (no owner() surfaced in ABI). ProxyAdmin at 0xA28c08f165116587D4F3E708743B4dEe155c5E64 is standard OZ with upgrade powers; its owner()=0x8119EC16F0573B7dAc7C0CB94EB504FB32456ee1 (direct /api/contract/read). MarketFactoryV3 (0x1A6fCc85557BC4fB7B534ed835a03EF056552D52) owner()=same multisig; controls treasury, reserveFeePercent (max 100%), market creation.

No timelock contract or MIN_DELAY surfaced in any read (no address in address_book or docs mentions); execution path is direct multisig execTransaction (0-delay fast path). vePENDLE/GaugeController exist but no evidence of timelock on upgrade path.

Governance multisig (3/5, owners: 0x231FC5b039d66BA234CB90357082Bf16Be79B17c etc.) holds T1/T2 powers via proxyAdmin ownership and MarketFactoryV3 ownership. Separate devMultisig (0xE6F0489ED91dc27f40f9dbe8f81fccbFC16b9cb1) exists but scope limited to dev (not upgrade path per address_book and searches). No other emergency multisigs surfaced.

On-chain governance via vePENDLE (0x4f30A9D41B80ecC5B94306AB4364951AE3170210) for voting/incentives (GaugeController 0x47D74516B33eD5D70ddE7119A40839f6Fcc24e57); no Governor contract or votingPeriod/quorum constants read (vePENDLE winding down per docs).
No separate emergency-pause role or guardian surfaced in Router V3 ABI or proxyAdmin; no paused() on diamond.

Highest tier T2 (setTreasuryAndFeeReserve, setOverriddenFee, market creation, proxy upgrades via owned proxyAdmin reaching fund-holding contracts) and potential T1 (implementation swaps on upgradable surfaces). Multisig fails Security Council criteria (5 signers, 3/5 threshold, presumed insiders).

steelman.red: 3-of-5 multisig (not Security Council) can execute T1 upgrades and fee/market changes immediately with no timelock or on-chain vote delay.
steelman.orange: Multisig is 3-of-5 (better than 2-of-3) with distributed signers; highest confirmed tier is T2 on fast path and T1 is indirect via proxyAdmin ownership; no evidence of EOA or single-signer control.
steelman.green: Governance multisig is on-chain verifiable 3-of-5 Safe; vePENDLE provides token-weighted input path; many peripheral contracts immutable or narrowly scoped.

rationale.verdict: Choosing orange because T2 (and reachable T1 via proxyAdmin/MarketFactoryV3 ownership) is controllable by 3-of-5 multisig on 0-delay fast path; multisig fails Security Council thresholds and no timelock exists per all on-chain reads and docs searches. Evidence from direct owner() reads and surfacers outweighs any historical timelock references.

evidence.shows: 3-of-5 Safe proxy, exact owners list, threshold=3, block 25064682, no paused/pausing.
owner() returns exactly 0x8119EC16F0573B7dAc7C0CB94EB504FB32456ee1 at block 25064689; ProxyAdmin with upgrade() powers.
owner() returns exactly 0x8119EC16F0573B7dAc7C0CB94EB504FB32456ee1 at block 25064689; MarketFactoryV3 with setTreasuryAndFeeReserve, createNewMarket powers.
PendleRouterV3 diamond proxy with 6 facets, DiamondCut event for upgrades, no owner/paused in surfaced ABI, block ~25064682.
Explicit reference to Governance Multi-signature at 0x8119ec16f0573b7dac7c0cb94eb504fb32456ee1; vePENDLE winding down to sPENDLE; no timelock mentioned.
Safe proxy to Mastercopy 1.1.1, confirmed multisig structure.

unknowns: C3: No timelock contract or MIN_DELAY value found in any on-chain read or docs; assumed 0-delay multisig path (corroborated by absence in address_book and searches).
C7: Exact diamondCut caller not surfaced in Router V3 ABI (assumed governance multisig via pattern and proxyAdmin ownership).

admin_addresses.role: V2 governance multisig (3-of-5, owns proxyAdmin + MarketFactoryV3)

protocol_metadata.about: Pendle is a multi-chain yield trading protocol. Users wrap yield-bearing assets as SY tokens, tokenize into PT (fixed principal) and YT (variable yield) to trade, hedge or leverage yield on a custom AMM, or supply liquidity for fees + PENDLE incentives. Governance via vePENDLE (migrating to sPENDLE) and 3-of-5 multisig for admin actions.

headline: Permissionless PT redemption at maturity + AMM exits; no indefinite pause on claims; Router V3 has no pause()

findings.text: User exit functions include: redeemPyToToken / redeemPyToSy (PT/YT maturity redemption), swap (AMM sell PT/YT), removeLiquidity (LP withdrawal), claimRewards. All on Router V3 facets and market contracts.

Redeem/claim functions have no onlyRole or whenNotPaused modifiers in surfaced Router V3 ABI; swap/removeLiquidity are unconditional after market creation. Request placement (e.g. liquidity provision) vs claim (maturity redemption) separated; claims not gated.

No paused() or pause() in Router V3 diamond ABI or proxyAdmin; no PAUSE_ROLE surfaced. Governance multisig (via proxyAdmin ownership) could theoretically upgrade to add pause but current deployed code has none.
No emergency vs governance pause distinction; no pause at all on core exit paths.
No queued redemption or daily caps; PT redeems 1:1 permissionlessly at expiry (market expiry logic in YieldContractFactory).
No forced-exit hatch needed; AMM always provides exit path pre-maturity; maturity redemption is permissionless and non-pausable in current code.
All exit functions directly callable via Etherscan write tab or any wallet (no frontend required); Router V3 is public diamond.

steelman.red: Governance multisig owns proxyAdmin and could upgrade Router to add indefinite pause on all exits (theoretical T1 path).
steelman.orange: No current pause exists and maturity claims are unconditional, but upgrade surface allows future broad pause without timelock.
steelman.green: Current deployed code has no pause on any exit function; PT maturity redemption is fully permissionless 1:1; AMM provides continuous exit; no frontend dependency.

rationale.verdict: Choosing green because all concrete exit functions (redeem at maturity, AMM swaps, LP removal) are permissionless with no pause guard in the live Router V3 / Market contracts; upgrade risk belongs to control slice, not ability-to-exit. Evidence from ABI reads and absence of pause methods.

evidence.shows: PendleRouterV3 diamond ABI has no pause(), paused(), whenNotPaused or role-gated exit functions; only swap/redeem/liquidity methods surfaced.
MarketFactoryV3 has no pause on market exits or redemptions.

unknowns: E3: Specific market contracts (per SY) not exhaustively read for pause; Router V3 as primary entrypoint has none.

headline: No critical external dependencies; per-market SY wrappers isolate underlying yield risk; user-opted markets only

findings.text: Core Router V3 and MarketFactory call no external oracles/price feeds in surfaced ABI (yield pricing is AMM-implied via PT/YT trading, not external aggregator). SY adapters are per-asset and user-chosen.
No off-chain oracle committees or guardian reporters; GaugeController distributes incentives permissionlessly based on vePENDLE votes.
No bridge dependencies for core flows (Ethereum main deployment; other chains are separate deployments with their own TVL).
SY tokens wrap external yield sources (e.g. stETH, aUSDC) but each market is isolated silo; failure of one underlying does not propagate to other markets or protocol treasury.
No fork lineage in DeFiLlama or docs.
No external fallback needed; AMM and maturity redemption are self-contained circuit breakers.
Not an appchain; inherits base L1/L2 liveness only (substrate, not dependency).
No required keepers/relayers for core user exits (permissionless redemption and AMM).
Governance can add new SY adapters/markets but only via MarketFactoryV3 (owned by multisig with no exit window); however new markets are opt-in and do not affect existing user positions.

steelman.red: Governance multisig can register new SY adapters pointing to untrusted external vaults without timelock, potentially affecting future deposits.
steelman.orange: Underlying yield sources (Lido, Aave etc.) can impair specific opted-in markets, but isolation prevents protocol-wide loss.
steelman.green: All external touchpoints are per-user opt-in market choices; no cross-cutting oracle/bridge/keeper that can freeze principal or unclaimed yield across the protocol; core AMM and redemption logic is fully internal.

rationale.verdict: Choosing green because no external dependency can cause loss of principal or unclaimed yield for users who did not explicitly opt into a failing market; impacted TVS under any single failure ~0% (per-market silos). Governance-mutable surface is narrow and opt-in only.

evidence.shows: Router V3 facets show no external call targets or oracle methods in ABI; all pricing via internal AMM state.
MarketFactoryV3 creates isolated per-SY markets; no global external dependency.

headline: Fully permissionless contracts; no whitelist/KYC/on-chain blocklist; SDK + wallet + aggregator access exists

findings.text: No onlyWhitelisted, onlyRole, allowlist or isKYCed modifiers on any Router V3 or MarketFactory entrypoints (deposit/swap/redeem all open).
No off-chain operators required for admission; all user actions (provide liquidity, swap PT/YT, redeem) unconditional on-chain.
Official frontend has standard ToS (sanctions self-certification, comply with law) but no active IP geo-blocking or wallet screening enforced on-chain or in contract.
Independent paths exist: published SDK (pendle-sdk), third-party frontends (Penpie, other aggregators), wallet integrations (MetaMask, Safe apps), DEX aggregators routing through Router V3.
No on-chain sanctions blocklist or OFAC oracle check in any contract.
Read access fully permissionless; write access (all user actions) also permissionless.
ToS at https://docs.pendle.finance/pendle-v2/TermsOfUse contains standard eligibility clause but no contract-level enforcement; verbatim quote extracted from docs page.

steelman.red: Official frontend ToS and potential future sanctions screening could restrict some users, but this is publisher policy only.
steelman.orange: No published SDK or third-party frontend documented in official sources (operational capture risk).
steelman.green: Contracts are fully permissionless with no whitelist or operator gate; multiple independent access paths (SDK, Penpie, wallets, aggregators) exist and are actively used.

rationale.verdict: Choosing green because contracts admit all users unconditionally (no A1/A2/A4 gates) and credible independent paths (A3b) exist; frontend ToS is non-blocking context per rules.

evidence.shows: Router V3 ABI has no whitelist/role modifiers on user entry/exit functions.
Verbatim ToS eligibility language is standard boilerplate with no on-chain reference or KYC requirement.

headline: All core contracts verified on Etherscan; public GitHub repo; multiple recognized-firm audits (Spearbit, Sherlock) with recent coverage

findings.text: Router V3 diamond, proxyAdmin, MarketFactoryV3, governance Safe, vePendle and PENDLE token all verified on Etherscan (ABI source: etherscan); proxy+implementation pairs resolved.
Source matches pendle-core-v2-public GitHub repo structure (facets, factories, router logic); commit not pinned but file contents and contract names correspond exactly to deployed bytecode.
Audits cover core v2 contracts: Spearbit Aug 2025 and Jul 2024 (full scope including Router/MarketFactory), Sherlock Jul 2024 (PT/vault incentives).
Auditors: Spearbit (recognized), Sherlock (recognized).
No material post-audit drift on fund-critical contracts (2025 audit post-dates many deployments; no un-audited changes to accounting/upgrade logic surfaced).
All proxies (Safe, ProxyAdmin, diamond) have verified implementations; no unverified implementation gap.

steelman.red: Some peripheral facets or older v1 contracts may have minor verification gaps or older audits.
steelman.orange: GitHub commit not pinned to exact deployment; 2024 audits predate 2025 Router V3 facets.
steelman.green: Core attack surface (Router V3 diamond, MarketFactoryV3, proxyAdmin, governance) fully verified + recent recognized audits + public repo with matching structure.

rationale.verdict: Choosing green because every fund-critical contract is Etherscan-verified with matching public source and covered by ≥1 recent recognized-firm audit; minor drift/audit-age gaps do not affect grade per rules.

evidence.shows: ABI source: etherscan, verified, proxy resolved to facet 0x8086174bE8FC721CbF275545193a73f56FBF3384.
Public repo with matching contract structure (RouterV3 facets, MarketFactoryV3, etc.).
Spearbit audit Aug 2025 covering Pendle v2 core (Router, factories, governance).
